bullets.text: Samsung and SoftBank Collaborate - **Samsung** and **SoftBank** join forces to advance **6G** and **AI-RAN** technologies.
T-Mobile US Achieves Record Growth - **T-Mobile US** reports its best Q3 in over a decade with 2.35 million new postpaid customers.
Vodafone's AI Network Automation - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to develop an AI platform for efficient **5G** network operations.
ZTE Wins Indoor Connectivity Award - **ZTE** recognized for its innovative indoor connectivity solutions at **Network X 2025**.
PSTN Switch-Off Approaches - UK businesses must prepare for the **PSTN** switch-off by January 2027 to avoid operational risks.
Vodafone's Black Sea Cable Project - **Vodafone** plans a new submarine cable to enhance connectivity in the Black Sea region.
Agentic AI in Telecoms - **Telcos** are poised to lead the AI economy, transforming customer interactions with **agentic AI**.
Germany's Fibre Transition - **Vodafone Germany** launches aggressive fibre tariffs to accelerate the shift from DSL to fibre.
MasOrange Reports Strong Synergies - **MasOrange** achieves €259 million in synergies, exceeding half of its 2025 target.
5G FWA Growth Forecast - Global **5G FWA** subscriptions expected to reach 150 million by 2030, driven by India and the US.
